name: babbel-export
description: Chrome extension scaffold for exporting data from Babbel

scripts.prepare-dist: npm run clean && npm run build && mkdir -p dist/popup && cp src/popup/popup.html dist/popup/ && cp src/popup/popup.css dist/popup/ && cp -r icons dist/ && cp manifest.json dist/
scripts.zip: npm run prepare-dist && cd dist && zip -r ../babbel-export.zip .
